row.title: Code comments and private spec text must not share wording (DISCLOSE-1)
row.body: Round-2 code comments had been copied verbatim into private requirement lines, so public files shared 12-word runs with the private specs while disclosure --check (which reads only specs/) passed. The comments were reworded, and the private sentences that quote test titles or code literals were reworded instead, keeping every requirement id; a 12-word-run scan of the changed files against the private specs ran and found no requirement-line run left. Write a comment in the code's own words and cite the requirement id; never reconcile a spec by pasting the comment.
row.probe: grep:workers/core/packs/lex.js::every unclosed bracket is pushed with its kind
